items.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004
items.q: I mean there was only one other one that ever was for the longest time and that was Earl Scruggs.

ctx.x: Do you get pressure from your record companies to, “Gee, if you guys could just sing” or, “if you could write another song like that.”

I don’t understand why I’m not getting that pressure. I mean we’re on SONY, they’re spending this big money. Our sales haven’t been that great. They have not put the phone down. Maybe it’s because we’re near the end of the deal and they want to re-sign us, I don’t know. But no, I’ve been very surprised, honestly. I don’t understand it, because I don’t think our records are making money for them but I think we’re probably the best seller they have right now on their jazz roster so maybe — I don’t know what it is.…
Have you ever been tempted to do more vocal work?
